edges.description: The substitutions are predicted to destabilize the signaling domain and lower the amount of active ligand. This is supported by in silico modeling of one allele only; no ACFD allele has been tested in a cell-based Hedgehog signaling assay.
IHH induces PTHrP, which holds proliferating chondrocytes back from hypertrophy. Less IHH weakens this brake. IHH also drives periarticular chondrocytes into the columnar zone independently of PTHrP.
intermediate_mechanisms: reduced IHH-induced PTHrP expression in the periarticular perichondrium
edges.target: Accelerated Hypertrophic Differentiation and Loss of Columnar Organization

edges.description: A smaller proliferative pool, together with faster hypertrophy, exhausts the growth plate early.

edges.source: Accelerated Hypertrophic Differentiation and Loss of Columnar Organization

edges.description: The cone shape is the radiographic form of an epiphysis that is fusing into its metaphysis early.

edges.description: A narrow thorax with short ribs follows from reduced endochondral rib growth. In the Ihh-deficient mouse, rib shortening restricts the chest enough to cause fatal respiratory failure. Rib growth plates have not been examined in patients.
Coxa vara develops alongside the abnormal proximal femoral epiphysis and short femoral neck. The exact steps are not described.
Variable. It is seen together with the hyperplastic distal femur and irregular proximal tibial metaphysis in some patients; the exact steps are not described.

The head is large relative to a body shortened by reduced endochondral growth. Head circumference ranges from the 3rd to the 98th centile in the published patients, so the head is not enlarged in absolute terms.
Secondary hip osteoarthritis in the adult proband, on a background of coxa vara, dysplastic acetabulum and a short femoral neck.
The reporting authors attribute the proband's waddling walk to genu varum.
Reproduces loss of columnar structure and ectopic hypertrophy in the postnatal growth plate.
edges.limitations: Complete deletion of Ihh from chondrocytes, whereas ACFD patients carry homozygous missense alleles whose residual activity is unknown. The mice also lose trabecular bone and articular surface, which are not established features of the human disease.
edges.source: Postnatal chondrocyte Ihh deletion (Col2a1-creERT; Ihh floxed) mouse

nodes.description: An egg-shaped capital femoral epiphysis, which gives the disorder the "capitofemoral" part of its name. It was present in all five patients in whom it was recorded. HPO has no term for an egg-shaped or cone-shaped femoral head: a label search of HP for "femoral head" returned hypoplasia, dysplasia, flattening, broadening, displacement, aplasia and delayed ossification terms, and "capital femoral epiphys" returned nothing. The binding is therefore to the epiphysis-level abnormality term.

nodes.description: Growth plates close early, before puberty. Epiphyses are cone-shaped while they are still open (hands, proximal femur, proximal humerus, distal tibia) and are later lost as the plates fuse. In all eight patients tabulated in 2025, longitudinal growth of the tubular bones of the hands and the long bones of the limbs was permanently reduced. Growth of the proximal femur is most visibly affected: the capital epiphysis is egg-shaped and the femoral neck is very short.

nodes.description: Less Hedgehog pathway activation in growth plate chondrocytes and perichondrium. When IHH binds Patched, Smoothened is released into the primary cilium and activates GLI transcription factors; with less IHH, less Smoothened reaches the cilium and GLI1 output falls. In ACFD the reduction is inferred from genetics and from mouse Ihh loss-of-function models. It has not been measured in patient cells.
